feed.title: DuoFine Engineering
feed.subtitle: Notes from production — what broke, how it was measured, and what actually fixed it.

entry.title: Self-hosting Poppins: subsets, unicode-range and the missing Turkish letters
entry.summary: The 'latin' subset of a Google Font does not contain ş, ğ or İ. What that looks like on a Turkish page, why the browser falls back mid-word, and the six-kilobyte fix with unicode-range and a metric-matched fallback.

entry.title: GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare: cache rules, and the purge you cannot skip
entry.summary: Two Cloudflare cache rules, content-hashed asset URLs and one manual step: how the HTML of a GitHub Pages site is served from the edge without ever being two hours stale by accident.

entry.title: A Content-Security-Policy you can ship from a meta tag
entry.summary: GitHub Pages cannot send response headers. A meta-tag Content-Security-Policy covers most of what you want — including dropping 'unsafe-inline' with script hashes — as long as you know the three directives it silently ignores.

entry.title: Consent Mode v2 on a static site, without a consent platform
entry.summary: How duofine.com runs Google Analytics 4 with Consent Mode v2 on a static site: nothing loads until the visitor says yes, the banner never becomes the LCP element, and there is no consent-management vendor in the loop.

entry.title: Fixing a 700ms PostgreSQL Query: From Seq Scan to 38ms
entry.summary: How a 700 ms PostgreSQL chat query was diagnosed with EXPLAIN ANALYZE and brought down to 38 ms using query-aligned compound B-tree indexes.
